question: A bike can finish a certain journey in 20 hours at the speed of 66 km/hr. In order to cover the same distance in 15 hours, the speed of the bike (in km/hr) must be increased by
solution:
**Given:**

Speed (s₁) = 66 km/hr

Time (t₁) = 20 hours

Time (t₂) = 15 hours

**Calculation:**

Distance = s₁ × t₁

⇒ Distance = 66 × 20

⇒ Distance = 1320 km

To cover the same distance in 15 hours:

⇒ Distance = s₂ × t₂

⇒ 1320 = s₂ × 15

⇒ s₂ = 1320 ÷ 15

⇒ s₂ = 88 km/hr

Increase in speed = s₂ - s₁

⇒ Increase = 88 - 66

⇒ Increase = 22 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
